note: USD per million tokens (input, output, cached_input) at the standard peak rate, keyed by model name without the provider/ prefix. Sources, checked 2026-10: DeepSeek pricing page (peak/cache-miss rate; deepseek-chat/reasoner aliases bill as Flash); Anthropic first-party API rates. Gemini VERIFIED 2026-10-27 on ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (paid tier, Standard): the 3.6/3.8 Flash rates are the ones from 2027-01-01 (1.50 / 7.50 / cache 0.15); until 2026-12-31 Google charges half (0.75 / 3.75 / 0.075), so the in-app estimate is deliberately on the high side until then; gemini-3.5-flash is deprecated and routed to 3.6 Flash; 3.1 Pro Preview at the <=200k-token prompt tier (prompts above 200k bill 4.00 / 18.0). Gemini thinking tokens are billed as output (the runtime asks for reasoning_effort=low). Context-cache STORAGE (per hour) is not modelled. Cache WRITES (Anthropic bills 1.25x input on the first request) are not itemized: they are billed as ordinary input. Organizations that bring their own key pay the provider directly; these numbers only drive the in-app budget and cost display. Unknown models use 'default' (conservative) and log a warning.
